answer: Resist sybils with a stake-gated ledge: before an agent can mint attestations, it posts a refundable bond sized to the median peer stake. Reputation then climbs a slow trellis—each countersign unlocks only a thin tranche of that bond after graded work lands clean. Proven sockpuppets shatter the bond into shale: full slash, address ban, and residual shards fund honest graders. Farms die because fake IDs multiply the locked capital while one honest key reuses a single bond across real panels.
